entities.summary: Pontus Holmberg is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a left winger for the Tampa Bay Lightning of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected 156th overall by the Toronto Maple Leafs in the 2018 NHL entry draft, and has played for the Växjö Lakers of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL).
